mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_quests WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quest_id = #{questId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations l WHERE l.area_code = #{areaCode} AND ( (SELECT COUNT(q.quest_id) FROM quests q WHERE q.location_id = l.location_id) > (SELECT COUNT(q2.quest_id) FROM user_quests uq JOIN quests q2 ON uq.quest_id = q2.quest_id WHERE q2.location_id = l.location_id AND uq.user_id = #{userId} AND uq.status = 'COMPLETED') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_quests (user_id, quest_id, status, accepted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questId}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_quests SET status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, completed_at = NOW(), last_updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_quest_id = #{userQuestId}
mapper.select: SELECT uq.quest_id, q.quest_type_id, q.title, q.description, uq.status, uq.accepted_at, l.title as location_name, q.reward_xp, q.reward_points FROM user_quests uq LEFT JOIN quests q ON uq.quest_id = q.quest_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON q.location_id = l.location_id WHERE uq.user_id = #{userId} AND uq.status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} ORDER BY uq.accepted_at DESC

SELECT uq.quest_id as questId, q.title as questTitle, q.description as questContent, l.title as locationName, uq.completed_at as completedAt FROM user_quests uq JOIN quests q ON uq.quest_id = q.quest_id JOIN locations l ON q.location_id = l.location_id WHERE uq.user_id = #{userId} AND uq.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY uq.completed_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(uq.user_quest_id) FROM user_quests uq JOIN quests q ON uq.quest_id = q.quest_id JOIN locations l ON q.location_id = l.location_id WHERE uq.user_id = #{userId} AND uq.status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.area_code = #{areaCode}

SELECT q.quest_id AS questId, q.title AS questTitle, -- 완료 수: user_quests에서 COMPLETED 상태인 것 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uq.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN uq.user_id END) AS completionCount,
-- 시도 수: system_logs에서 해당 퀘스트(target_id)에 대한 인증 시도 횟수 -- (주의: 아직 로그가 없는 퀘스트는 0이 될 수 있으므로, 최소한 완료 수보다는 크거나 같아야 함) GREATEST( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uq.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN uq.user_id END), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_logs sl WHERE sl.target_id = q.quest_id AND sl.feature_name LIKE '%complete%Quest%') ) AS acceptanceCount,
-- 완료율 계산 CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_logs sl WHERE sl.target_id = q.quest_id AND sl.feature_name LIKE '%complete%Quest%') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uq.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN uq.user_id END) * 100.0 / GREATEST(1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_logs sl WHERE sl.target_id = q.quest_id AND sl.feature_name LIKE '%complete%Quest%'))) END AS completionRate FROM quests q LEFT JOIN user_quests uq ON q.quest_id = uq.quest_id GROUP BY q.quest_id, q.title ORDER BY completionRate DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN l.area_code = 1 THEN '서울' WHEN l.area_code = 2 THEN '인천' WHEN l.area_code = 3 THEN '대전' WHEN l.area_code = 4 THEN '대구' WHEN l.area_code = 5 THEN '광주' WHEN l.area_code = 6 THEN '부산' WHEN l.area_code = 7 THEN '울산' WHEN l.area_code = 8 THEN '세종' WHEN l.area_code = 31 THEN '경기' WHEN l.area_code = 32 THEN '강원' WHEN l.area_code = 33 THEN '충북' WHEN l.area_code = 34 THEN '충남' WHEN l.area_code = 35 THEN '경북' WHEN l.area_code = 36 THEN '경남' WHEN l.area_code = 37 THEN '전북' WHEN l.area_code = 38 THEN '전남' WHEN l.area_code = 39 THEN '제주' ELSE '기타' END AS areaName, COUNT(uq.user_quest_id) as completedCount FROM user_quests uq JOIN quests q ON uq.quest_id = q.quest_id JOIN locations l ON q.location_id = l.location_id WHERE uq.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY areaName ORDER BY completedCount DESC
